diagnostic_change: Each successful cycle records maximum target delta, its joint, and whether the optional delta stop is enabled. Fault records include the last successfully read state snapshot with its received timestamp, after requesting stop.
operation: Short supervised forward request +0.25 to +0.30 m/s for 1-2 seconds, then center sticks; fall-catching support must clear all legs, with clear space in front. L2 if the robot does not alternate steps or body support becomes asymmetric. No automatic stop after 2 seconds.
limitation: A bounded finite candidate does not prove safe subsequent closed-loop behavior. Standing and the requested crouched posture do not validate walking.
